Involvement

Act Two

Moonrise Towers Prison

The Warden can be spoken to at her post in Moonrise Towers Prison. She alternates between remaining inside her room, patrolling to the ominous fleshy hole in the ground, or speaking to  Wulbren.

The party can attempt to obtain her permission to speak to the prisoners with a variety of class and skill-specific Ability checks. No matter the choice, she suggests some light bribery may convince her to turn a blind eye, only to ultimately rebuff the interacting player character regardless of whether they bribe her. If paid, rogues have the option of complimenting her extortion skills and party members with the Noble background receive the ⁠Can't Bribe 'Em All inspiration.

If the player character is the Dark Urge, the Warden is embittered seeing them again, annoyed at the deference members of the Cult were expected to show them when they first stayed at Moonrise Towers. The Warden pointedly remarks that she knows the things the Urge did in the past, and mentions her belief that they remain a threat to  Ketheric Thorm.

Defending Moonrise Towers

If the  Nightsong is freed and the Harpers assault Moonrise Towers, the Warden becomes hostile and moves to the throne room on the ground floor.
